summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K press release on August 17, 2026, reporting an unplanned outage at its Lake Superior Power generating facility, which caused a temporary suspension of electric arc furnace (EAF) production. The company expects the outage to last no more than 21 days, with a potential earlier restart through alternative power arrangements with the IESO. This is an operational disruption announcement, not a special-situation event. There are no deal terms, board actions, or strategic corporate changes. The filing is a routine current report of operational developments, with no impact on corporate structure or control.
